# Quaternius Stylized Nature MegaKit — curated Standard subset

- Creator: Quaternius (`@Quaternius`)
- Pack: Stylized Nature MegaKit, Standard (free)
- Official source: https://quaternius.com/packs/stylizednaturemegakit.html
- Official mirror: https://quaternius.itch.io/stylized-nature-megakit
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal; the pack notice is preserved in `LICENSE.txt`.
- Retrieval mirror: https://github.com/anandin/the-wild-between/tree/main/assets/quaternius-nature

Only the mobile-suitable scenes used by Dustbound Expedition are vendored: two pines, two common trees, bush, fern, two grasses, one flower group, two rocks, and their referenced textures/buffers. The original glTF geometry and texture files are unmodified.
